resources.string: On your PC, open Lights Out › Settings › Phone Companion and choose Same Wi-Fi. Then scan its QR code below, or paste the link.
Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Enter a valid link like http://192.168.1.50:58732/?t=…
Point the camera at the QR code in Lights Out › Settings › Phone Companion on your PC.
Camera permission is needed to scan the QR code.
Couldn\'t reach that PC. Check the link and Wi-Fi, and that Phone Companion is set to Same Wi-Fi on the PC.
